tours.title: Tours
tours.description: Every tour, past, running and future. The state is read off the dates.
tours.readyProblems: Before it can be marked ready, it still needs:

tourTemplates.title: Tour templates

tourFromTemplate.description: The tour is born as a draft with the settings of the template; the dates are chosen afterwards.
tourFromTemplate.none: There are no tour templates yet.

tourSaveAsTemplate.description: The settings of this tour become a template: no dates, address or award.

aircraftProfiles.title: Aircraft profiles
aircraftProfiles.description: How fast each aircraft type flies: the speed the estimated time of a leg is computed with.

delete.title: Delete this profile?

aircraftGroups.title: Aircraft groups
aircraftGroups.description: Named sets of aircraft types, usable wherever a tour chooses its aircraft.

delete.title: Delete this group?
delete.description: Tours that allow this group no longer allow its types through it.

settings.title: Tour settings
settings.description: What the department changes without a release: limits, windows and the estimated time.
settings.toursInTheWay: These tours have no daily limit of their own: give them one before switching the division's off.

fields.rejectGraceHours: Hours of grace after a rejection
fields.leaseMinutes: Minutes a taken report stays with its validator
fields.durationFactor: Estimated time: share added to the distance (0.05 = 5%)
fields.retentionMonthsLong: Months the disciplinary record is kept
fields.thresholdToleranceMeters: Take-off distance allowed from the threshold (m)

errors.templateFixed: A tour does not become a template, nor a template a tour: use "Save as template" or "New from template".
errors.templateNeverReady: A template is not marked ready: a tour is created from it.
errors.releasedStaysReady: The tour has been released and does not go back to draft: it can be hidden.
errors.slugTaken: This address already belongs to another tour.
errors.dailyLimitRequired: The division's daily limit is off: the tour needs one of its own.

errors.tourHasReports: This tour has reports and is not deleted: it can be hidden.
errors.toursNeedDailyLimit: Some tours still to be flown have no daily limit of their own.

errors.airportUnknown: The hub does not know this airport.

errors.kindHasNoLegs: An Open tour and a tour with subtours have no legs.
errors.tourClosed: The tour is closed: nothing comes back into it.

errors.rotationNotAtHub: A rotation leaves its hub with its first leg and returns there with its last.
errors.rotationUnknown: This rotation is not part of the tour.
errors.rotationHasLegs: This rotation has legs: move or remove them first.
errors.legNotInRotation: In a hub tour every leg is part of a rotation, or connects two hubs.
errors.connectionNotBetweenHubs: A connection goes from one hub of the tour to another.
errors.connectionHasNoRotation: A connection between hubs is not part of a rotation.
errors.kindHasNoHubs: Only a hub tour has hubs and rotations.
errors.legHubOnly: Rotations and connections belong to a hub tour.
errors.templateHasNoHubs: A template has no hubs: they are written in the tour made from it.
errors.hubTaken: This airport is already a hub of the tour.
errors.hubUnknown: This hub is not part of the tour.
errors.hubHasRotations: This hub has rotations: remove them first.
errors.containerNeedsSubtours: A tour with subtours has at least two.
errors.requiredSubtoursTooMany: It asks for more subtours than it has.
errors.containerHasSubtours: This tour has subtours: it keeps its kind and is deleted after them.
errors.parentUnknown: A subtour belongs to a tour with subtours that is not a template.
errors.subtourNotContainer: A subtour does not have subtours of its own.
errors.subtourHasNoAward: A subtour has no award: the award is its container's.
errors.subtourOutsideParent: The dates of a subtour are inside its container's period.
errors.subtoursOutsideParent: A ready subtour has dates of its own outside this period.
errors.airlineCode: Write the airline as its three letter code.
errors.callsign: Write the callsign in letters and digits, without spaces.
errors.exactOnlyDenies: A whole callsign can only be denied: an allowed airline leaves the rest to the pilot.
errors.kindHasNoConstraints: Filters and sequence rules belong to open tours (Open) only.
errors.constraintsContradict: Eastbound and westbound together: no flight can follow both.

errors.constraintTaken: The tour already has one of this kind.

errors.distanceBoundRequired: At least one bound is needed: minimum or maximum.

errors.firCode: A FIR is its code, for example EDGG.
errors.parameterChoice: Not one of the possible choices.
errors.countryUnknown: A country with no airport the hub knows.
errors.firUnknown: A FIR the hub does not know.
errors.importNotOnHub: A hub tour does not import legs: they belong to rotations a file cannot name. Write them in the table.
errors.importReasonRequired: This import retires, restores or changes legs with reports: say why.
errors.importTooManyRows: The file has too many rows for the legs of one tour.
errors.ruleCode: Letters, digits, dots and dashes, up to 16.
errors.generalAmendsNothing: A general rule amends nothing: only a tour's rule does.
errors.yearlyMaxOnlyWarning: Only a warning has a yearly maximum.
errors.amendedUnknown: The rule amended is not a general rule in force.
errors.alreadyAmended: This tour already amends that rule.
errors.ruleCodeTaken: Another rule already has this code.
errors.errorUnknown: One of the errors does not exist.
errors.ruleHasAmendments: Some tours amend this rule: remove their amendments first, or retire it.

legs.empty: No legs yet: add the first one.

actions.closeTour: Close the tour (back to the first departure)

remove.title: Remove leg {{number}}?
remove.Delete: No report points at this leg: it is deleted, and the legs after it are renumbered.
remove.Retire: Reports point at this leg: it is not deleted but retired. It is no longer flown and leaves the public page; its reports stay and are validated. Say why.
remove.RetireRotation: Reports point at this leg, and a rotation is retired whole: legs {{numbers}} are retired. Say why.

restore.title: Restore leg {{number}}?
restore.description: The leg is flown again, and comes back to the public page. Say why.

import.title: Import legs from a file
import.help: XLSX, XLS, ODS or CSV. The header may be in any of the first rows; the columns are found by name ({{columns}}, or “Departure ICAO” and “Destination ICAO”), departure and arrival are required. The order of the rows is the order of the tour, and every row that is not empty is a leg: notes, totals and drafts must be taken out of the sheet. A leg is the same leg when departure and arrival are the same. A cell may hold more than one callsign or flight number (ITY1357/1365, or separated by commas); aircraft are ICAO types, the groups of a leg stay as they are; the release is in UTC.

file.label: File
file.refused: The file cannot be imported as it is
file.release: Row {{line}}: the release is not a date (a date cell, or 2026-10-01 18:00 in UTC).
file.unreadable: This file cannot be read as a spreadsheet.
file.noHeader: None of the first rows names a departure and an arrival column (for example “Departure ICAO” and “Destination ICAO”).

mode.label: Legs that are not in the file
mode.Merge: Merge: leave them as they are
mode.Replace: Replace: the file is the whole tour

explain.Merge: The legs the file does not contain stay where they are. A partial file is fine.
explain.Replace: The legs the file does not contain are deleted if no report points at them, and retired with a reason if one does.

import.reason: Why (it retires, restores or changes legs with reports)

delete.title: Delete this hub?
delete.description: A hub with rotations is not deleted: remove its rotations first.

delete.title: Delete this rotation?
delete.description: A rotation with legs is not deleted: move or remove its legs first.

delete.title: Delete this constraint?
delete.description: Pilots are no longer held to it from the next report.

hints.value: An airline is its three letter code: what follows it is the pilot's choice. A whole callsign is only denied.

goals.Distance: The tour is complete when the great-circle distances of the accepted flights add up to the miles given.
goals.FlightCount: The tour is complete after the number of accepted flights given.
goals.DistinctAirports: The tour is complete when the accepted flights have touched the number of different airports given.
goals.DistinctCountries: The tour is complete when the accepted flights have touched the number of different countries given.
goals.CollectList: The tour is complete when the accepted flights have touched the airports of the list: all of them, or as many as you say.
goals.CollectRegions: The tour is complete when the accepted flights have touched the countries or FIRs of the list: all of them, or as many as you say.

constraints.title: Filters and sequence rules
constraints.description: A flight that breaks a filter or a rule cannot be reported. The same route is never flown twice: that always holds, and needs no row.

delete.title: Delete this filter or rule?
delete.description: From the next report on, pilots no longer have to follow it.

fields.parameters.meters: Longest runway at arrival, at most (m)
fields.parameters.feet: Elevation of the arrival airport, at least (ft)

hints.parameters.minNm: One of the two bounds is enough.

explain.DepartureOrArrivalIn: Every flight departs or arrives in one of the countries given.
explain.DepartureIn: Every flight departs from one of the countries given.
explain.ArrivalIn: Every flight arrives in one of the countries given.
explain.TouchesAirport: Every flight departs or arrives at one of the airports given: a "star" tour.
explain.DistanceBetween: The great-circle distance of every flight is between the minimum and the maximum.
explain.AircraftCategory: Every flight with an aircraft of one of the wake categories given. The types and groups admitted are in the tour's settings.
explain.ArrivalRunwayMax: Every flight lands on a runway no longer than the length given.
explain.ArrivalElevationMin: Every flight arrives at an airport at least as high as given.
explain.FlightRules: Every flight under the flight rules given.
explain.Chained: Every flight departs where the pilot's previous flight arrived: no teleporting.
explain.Eastbound: Every flight arrives further east than it departed.
explain.Westbound: Every flight arrives further west than it departed.
explain.IncreasingDistance: Every flight is longer than the one before.
explain.MinFlightsAt: On completion, at least the number of flights given have touched the airport. One per airport.

rules.title: General rules
rules.description: The rules of every tour. A tour may amend one of them, changing its text or its numbers, and add rules of its own.

delete.title: Delete this rule?
delete.description: Reports already sent keep the rules they were sent with. To keep it on record, retire it instead.

fields.title: Title
fields.parameters.radiusNm: Landing within (NM of the arrival airport)

hints.code: As the regulation names it, for example GR4. Once among the general rules, once among a tour's.
hints.parameters: A number left empty is the check's starting value, or on an amendment the value of the rule it amends.
hints.errorIds: The errors a validator marks when the rule is broken. A rule with none is shown in the list.
hints.retired: A retired rule no longer holds on any tour, and is no longer copied.

rules.amendingHint: This tour holds this rule in place of the general one. Fill in only the numbers it changes: the others stay those of the general rule, even when it changes.
rules.effectiveDescription: What holds on this tour: the general rules, each replaced by the amendment of this tour where there is one, then the tour's own. A subtour holds its container's first.
rules.noneInForce: No rule holds on this tour yet.

copy.title: Copy the rules of another tour
copy.description: Adds the rules of that tour, with their parameters and errors. What this tour already has stays: a rule with the same code, or an amendment of the same general rule.
copy.skipped: Not copied, the tour already has them: {{codes}}.

explain.none: No automatic check: the validator judges this one alone.
explain.callsign: The callsign is one the tour allows. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.aircraft: The aircraft type is one the tour allows. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.landingAtArrival: The flight landed at the arrival airport, or declared a diversion.
explain.disconnections: The flight was not disconnected longer than allowed, once or in total.
explain.parking: The aircraft stood still at the gate before pushback and after arrival.
explain.speed250: No more than 250 kt below FL100, with the tolerance given.
explain.simRate: The speed reported agrees with the speed between positions.
explain.alternate: The flight plan names an alternate; ZZZZ only with ALTN/ in the remarks.
explain.equipment: The flight plan declares the equipment required.
explain.takeoffFromThreshold: The take-off roll started at the threshold. The tolerance is one for the division, in the settings.
explain.vmc: VMC at departure and arrival, on VFR flight plans only.
explain.repeatedRoute: A route already flown in a distance or open tour; A to B is not B to A. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.semicircularLevels: Cruise levels by direction. Run on the validator's computer, with its navigation data.
explain.atcCoverage: The controllers online along the route. Run on the validator's computer, with its navigation data.

tourErrors.title: Errors
tourErrors.description: The division's catalogue of the errors a validator marks on a report. Public errors can be shown on a page with the block "Public errors".

delete.title: Delete this error?
delete.description: It is taken off every rule it belongs to. To keep it on record, retire it instead.

hints.yearlyMax: A warning only: beyond this many times in a year, rejection is suggested.

errorCatalog.label: Public errors
errorCatalog.warningMax_one: Warning, once a year at most
errorCatalog.warningMax_other: Warning, {{count}} times a year at most

hints.states: Nothing chosen shows every tour the public sees.

public.title: Tours
public.description: Fly the tours of the division: a route, a set of rules, and a validator who reads every report.
public.none: No tour is open right now.
public.errors: Errors a report can be given
